rules: Only primitives implemented in runtime count as shipped primitives.
Generated event families are taxonomy targets until replay, debug, manual gate, and recovery evidence exists.
Every promoted event must define replay semantics, audit payload, failure states, and recovery behavior.

families.replaySemantics: wait until DOM/task readiness predicate or timeout reserve is reached
families.recoveryBehavior: soft_abort_if_budget_exceeded or continue in shadow mode

families.replaySemantics: insert deterministic idle or stable-content wait based on seed and page archetype
families.recoveryBehavior: clip to timeout budget and preserve warning

families.replaySemantics: perform deterministic progressive scroll or ratio scroll for scan phases
families.recoveryBehavior: record skipped step or soft abort

families.replaySemantics: focus, blur, or hover candidate elements selected by page archetype
families.recoveryBehavior: skip target-specific step and preserve audit warning

families.replaySemantics: type with rhythm and optional correction events inside form/auth archetypes
families.recoveryBehavior: manual gate or fail with field-level reason

families.replaySemantics: pause on content regions using deterministic dwell budget and page archetype
families.recoveryBehavior: skip dwell or clip to remaining budget while preserving audit warning

families.replaySemantics: persist session state at deterministic checkpoints after navigation or form phases
families.recoveryBehavior: record persistence failure and continue only when task policy allows degraded session continuity

families.replaySemantics: evaluate remaining time/action budget and soft-abort low value phases deterministically
families.recoveryBehavior: soft abort, emit skipped step list, and preserve task-level recovery reason

families.currentEvidence: operator commands and manual gate confirm/reject runtime surface are wired for local replay audit
families.runtimePath: src/desktop/mod.rs confirm_manual_gate/reject_manual_gate and task run detail operator surface

localRuntimeBacking.boundary: local operator gate only; no external provider account is required

families.replaySemantics: pause replay at declared manual gate and wait for operator decision or timeout
families.recoveryBehavior: resume, abort, or retry according to explicit operator decision

families.currentEvidence: BehaviorTraceSummary and run detail audit artifacts are wired for local replay audit
families.runtimePath: src/desktop/mod.rs read_desktop_behavior_audit_contract and run detail artifacts
families.replaySemantics: emit deterministic trace events around each planned/executed/skipped primitive
families.recoveryBehavior: keep task result but mark audit as degraded when trace persistence fails

families.currentEvidence: CAPTCHA/SMS/Email readiness, dry-run, failure taxonomy and operator surface are wired; real credential smoke remains separate
families.runtimePath: scripts/provider_acceptance_preflight.ps1 and Settings provider readiness surface

localRuntimeBacking.boundary: local dry-run and operator readiness only; CAPTCHA/SMS/Email real account credentials are not verified

families.replaySemantics: delegate provider challenge/code steps to manager, then detect/fill through browser automation when wired
families.recoveryBehavior: surface operator gate or fail with provider-level failure reason
